title: Calculation of Consumer Northgate Cash Earnings
content:
**Clause.** For a Northgate Rewards, Northgate+ Assist, Northgate+ Student, Northgate+ Monthly or Northgate+ Annual membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the line this consumer schedule settles is the line recorded first on the member's Northgate order that has the latest fulfilled date among the member's orders in fulfilled status, on a shared latest date the order of them recorded first; when the member has no Northgate order in fulfilled status, nothing is posted.

The consumer earning is the line's earning basis multiplied by the earning percentage, divided by 100 and rounded half up to the cent, and it posts on the order's fulfilled date.

- **Earning basis.** The line's net amount: the amount paid for the line after item promotions and the Northgate Card discount, before tax, fees, gift cards and Northgate Cash, as the order line records it.
- **Earning percentage.** The tier's Northgate Cash earn rate, as the tier's earning schedule states it.
- **Lines that never earn.** Lines of the purchase types the tier excludes from earning never earn, and a line earns only if the membership is not canceled on the fulfilled date; such a line posts nothing.

**When an earning is posted.** An earning is posted for the line this consumer schedule settles only when the line is not of a purchase type that never earns Northgate Cash, the membership is not canceled on its order's fulfilled date and the line's earning under the consumer earning schedule comes to at least one cent; otherwise nothing is posted.

**Rounding point.** Rounding happens once, on the earning itself, half up to the cent.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures)**

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| net amount of the selected line | 410.00 |
| earning percentage | 1 |
| membership canceled on the fulfilled date | no |
| earning | 410.00 multiplied by 1, divided by 100, that is 4.10 |

A second illustration of the rounding point: a net amount of 64.50 at 1 percent gives 0.645, which rounds half up to 0.65.

**Outcomes at a glance**

| Situation on the fulfilled date | Earning posted |
|---|---|
| no Northgate order in fulfilled status | nothing |
| the selected line is an excluded purchase type | nothing |
| the membership is canceled on the fulfilled date | nothing |
| the earning rounds to less than one cent (for instance a hypothetical net amount of 0.40 at 1 percent, 0.004, rounding to 0.00) | nothing |
| otherwise | the earning basis multiplied by the earning percentage, divided by 100, rounded half up to the cent |
